Name: Portraits - A Semi-Realistic Interpretation of Vanilla Portraits (Content Patcher)
Author: mrhappyartworks
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/30990805-1743379562.jpg[/img]Hi everyone, this is Portraits - A Semi-Realistic Interpretation of Vanilla Portraits (Content Patcher).

These are portraits drawn by me to give the Pelican townspeople a refreshing look. My goal is to approach these characters with a more realistic feature while maintaining their character and vibes of their vanilla counterparts. I keep mostly the angle of the characters' portraits to be quite close to their vanilla angle, but I find my freedom of interpretation elsewhere. Those areas include some minor detail such as how their bodies move when they express different emotion, or how they include their hand gestures into some conversation. These might be subtle, but I believe they help a lot with conveying life and character.

Currently I have only made the bachelorettes' portraits. Following will be the bachelors', and then the rest of townspeople. I wish this could extend also to the characters of SVE, but I'd rather keep a realistic expectation of myself XD.

Still, it is my own interpretation, if you like what you see, please download and enjoy them! 



[size=4]Installation[/size]

[size=2]1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Either unzip [CP]mrhappyartworks's Portraits_Bachelorette to the Mods folder in your game directory, or install it via mod loaders such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url].
3. To be able to toggle this mod or specific character on and off easily, please also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
